customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the member profile.

name.meaning: Member's full legal name as on the state Medicaid record.

date_of_birth.meaning: Member's date of birth; an identity verification credential.

medicaid_id.format: 10 characters: 2 letters followed by 8 digits (e.g. PR48213377)
medicaid_id.meaning: State Medicaid recipient ID printed on the member ID card; an identity verification credential.

ssn_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the member's Social Security number; an identity verification credential.

phone_number.meaning: Member's phone number on file; an identity verification credential.

email.meaning: Member's email address on file; empty when none.

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the member's residential address; an identity verification credential.

mailing_address.meaning: Member's mailing address on file, used for cards and notices.

county.meaning: County of residence, which sets the service area.

county_type.meaning: Urban or rural designation of the county of residence as published by the state for network standards.

sex.meaning: Sex recorded on the state Medicaid record.

preferred_language.meaning: Language the member prefers for calls and notices.

household_size.meaning: Number of persons in the Medicaid household on the state file.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the member profile was first opened at Prairie Ridge.

membership_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership (enrollment spell) record.

variant_name.meaning: Eligibility category assigned by the state, written as the official category name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the membership (see the plan charter lifecycle).

enrollment_date.meaning: Date the state enrollment file assigned the member to Prairie Ridge; anchors the plan change window.

coverage_start_date.meaning: First day of coverage of this enrollment spell.

renewal_due_date.meaning: Date the current eligibility period ends and renewal is due.

termination_date.meaning: Last day of coverage; empty while coverage continues (also the procedural coverage end date during reconsideration).

termination_reason.meaning: Why coverage ended; not_applicable while coverage continues.

assignment_type.meaning: Whether the member chose Prairie Ridge or the state auto-assigned them.

income_pct_fpl.format: integer percent of the federal poverty level
income_pct_fpl.meaning: Household income as a whole percent of FPL as printed on the state enrollment file.

household_income_monthly.meaning: Monthly household income on the state enrollment file; basis of the cost-sharing cap.

premium_balance.meaning: CHIP premium billed and not yet paid or waived (integral of the premium_due account; never negative).

ai_an_status.meaning: Whether the state file records the member as American Indian or Alaska Native.

notice_channel.meaning: Member's preferred additional channel for renewal and plan notices.

suspension_start_date.meaning: First day of the current incarceration suspension; empty when not suspended.

plan_claim_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim ledger row.

membership_id.meaning: Membership the claim is booked on (foreign key -> plan_memberships).

claim_number.meaning: Claim number printed on the explanation of benefits (e.g. C26-0714-55120); empty on refund rows.

related_claim_number.meaning: Claim number of the original claim an adjustment or refund points back to; empty on original claims.

service_date.meaning: First date of service of the claim.

service_category.meaning: Copay category of the claim; not_applicable on refund rows.

provider_npi.meaning: National Provider Identifier of the billing provider.

plan_paid_amount.meaning: Amount Prairie Ridge paid on the claim.

member_cost_share.meaning: Member copay: positive when assessed, negative when reversed by an adjustment or refunded over the cap.

denial_code.meaning: Reason a claim was denied or reversed; none when paid.

cost_share_period.format: YYYY-Qn for quarterly caps, YYYY for annual caps
cost_share_period.meaning: Cap period the service date falls in (refund rows: the period refunded).

plan_premium_id.meaning: Primary id of the premium ledger row.

membership_id.meaning: Membership the premium belongs to (foreign key -> plan_memberships).

coverage_month.meaning: Coverage month the premium row applies to.

amount.meaning: Amount billed, applied or waived (always positive; direction comes from the event family).

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; not_applicable on bills and waivers.

payment_reference.meaning: Payment confirmation number; empty on bills and waivers.

waiver_reason.meaning: Reason a month was waived; not_applicable otherwise.

posted_date.meaning: Date the row posted (for bills: the billing date).

plan_notice_id.meaning: Primary id of the notice or card issue row.

membership_id.meaning: Membership the notice belongs to (foreign key -> plan_memberships).

notice_type.meaning: Which renewal notice; not_applicable on card rows.

card_reason.meaning: Why an ID card was issued; not_applicable on renewal notices.

renewal_cycle_date.meaning: renewal_due_date of the renewal cycle a notice belongs to; empty on card rows.

delivery_channel.meaning: Channel the notice or card was delivered through.

change_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the plan change request.

membership_id.meaning: Membership the request concerns (foreign key -> plan_memberships).

request_type.meaning: Kind of change requested or reported.

reported_value.meaning: New address or income exactly as the member states it on a change report; empty otherwise.

cause_code.meaning: Documented cause for a for-cause change; not_applicable otherwise.

requested_plan_name.meaning: Name of the health plan the member asks to move to, exactly as stated; empty for disenrollment and change reports.

request_status.meaning: Handling status: recorded, forwarded to the state enrollment broker (plan changes) or to the state eligibility office (address and income reports), or withdrawn by the member.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

pcp_assignment_id.meaning: Primary id of the PCP assignment record.

membership_id.meaning: Plan membership the assignment belongs to (foreign key -> plan_memberships).

variant_name.meaning: Practice type of the assigned provider, as the official name.

provider_npi.meaning: NPI of the assigned primary care provider.

provider_name.meaning: Name of the assigned provider as listed in the provider directory.

practice_name.meaning: Name of the practice or clinic as listed in the provider directory.

end_date.meaning: Last day of the assignment; empty while open.

end_reason.meaning: Why the assignment ended; not_applicable while open.

distance_miles.meaning: Straight-line miles from the member's residence to the practice.

pcp_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the PCP event row.

pcp_assignment_id.meaning: Assignment the event belongs to (foreign key -> pcp_assignments).

event_date.meaning: Date of the request, notice, referral or attempt.

change_reason.meaning: Reason for a change request; not_applicable on other rows.

requested_provider_npi.meaning: NPI of the provider the member chose; empty on other rows.

notice_reason.meaning: Reason of an exit or dismissal notice.

effective_date.meaning: Provider exit date or dismissal effective date; empty on other rows.

referral_number.meaning: Referral number (e.g. RF-2608-30417); empty on other rows.

specialist_npi.meaning: NPI of the specialist referred to; empty on other rows.

referral_visits.meaning: Visits covered by the referral; 0 on other rows.

pcp_visit_id.meaning: Primary id of the visit row.

pcp_assignment_id.meaning: Assignment the visit was with (foreign key -> pcp_assignments).

visit_mode.meaning: Whether the visit was in person or by telehealth.

claim_number.meaning: Claim number of the visit claim, matching plan_claims.claim_number.

authorization_id.meaning: Primary id of the authorization record.

customer_id.meaning: Member the authorization is for (foreign key -> customers).

membership_id.meaning: Plan membership the request falls under (foreign key -> plan_memberships).

variant_name.meaning: Authorization class, as the official name.

auth_number.meaning: Authorization number given to the member and provider (e.g. PA-2607-114382).

service_code.meaning: CPT or HCPCS code of the service requested (e.g. 97110, E0601).

therapy_discipline.meaning: Therapy discipline for rehabilitation therapy requests; not_applicable otherwise.

requesting_provider_npi.meaning: NPI of the provider who requested the authorization.

servicing_provider_npi.meaning: NPI of the provider who will deliver the service.

network_status.meaning: Network status of the servicing provider.

review_type.meaning: Review timeframe the request is handled under.

prior_plan_auth_number.meaning: Authorization number issued by the member's prior health plan, for transition of care; empty otherwise.

received_date.meaning: Date the complete request was received; starts the decision clock.

decision_date.meaning: Date of the approval or denial; empty while undecided.

start_date.meaning: First date units may be used (requested date until approved).

end_date.meaning: Last date units may be used; empty until approved.

units_requested.meaning: Units requested, in the class's unit_basis.

units_approved.meaning: Total units approved including extensions; 0 until approved.

units_remaining.meaning: Units granted and not yet used or released (integral of the authorized_units account).

denial_reason.meaning: Reason for a denial; not_applicable otherwise.

closed_date.meaning: Date the authorization expired, was voided or withdrawn; empty while open.

auth_unit_id.meaning: Primary id of the unit ledger row.

authorization_id.meaning: Authorization the units belong to (foreign key -> auth_authorizations).

units.meaning: Units granted, used or released (direction comes from the event family).

grant_type.meaning: Why units were granted; not_applicable on use and release rows.

release_reason.meaning: Why units were released; not_applicable otherwise.

claim_number.meaning: Claim number that used the units; empty on grant and release rows.

service_date.meaning: Service date of the claim that used the units; empty otherwise.

auth_action_id.meaning: Primary id of the action or notice row.

authorization_id.meaning: Authorization the action belongs to (foreign key -> auth_authorizations).

action_date.meaning: Date of the request, extension or notice.

requested_by.meaning: Who asked for the expedite, extension or deadline extension.

provider_certified_urgent.meaning: Whether a provider certified urgency on an expedite request; false otherwise.

requested_units.meaning: Additional units requested on an extension request; 0 otherwise.

requested_end_date.meaning: End date requested on an extension request; empty otherwise.

extension_days.meaning: Days added to the decision deadline; 0 otherwise.

notice_type.meaning: Which notice was sent; not_applicable on request rows.

delivery_channel.meaning: Channel a notice was sent through.

rx_coverage_id.meaning: Primary id of the pharmacy coverage record.

membership_id.meaning: Plan membership the coverage belongs to (foreign key -> plan_memberships).

variant_name.meaning: Pharmacy benefit plan, as the official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the pharmacy coverage.

end_date.meaning: Last day of pharmacy coverage; empty while open.

end_reason.meaning: Why coverage ended; not_applicable while open.

lock_in_pharmacy_npi.meaning: Lock-in pharmacy; empty when not locked in.

lock_in_prescriber_npi.meaning: Lock-in prescriber of controlled substances; empty when not locked in.

lock_in_start_date.meaning: First lock-in day; empty when never locked in.

lock_in_end_date.meaning: Last lock-in day; empty when never locked in.

otc_balance.meaning: OTC allowance left for the current quarter (integral of the otc_allowance account).

rx_fill_id.meaning: Primary id of the pharmacy claim row.

rx_number.meaning: Prescription number printed on the label (e.g. 6204418).

fill_date.meaning: Date filled or attempted (reversal rows: the original fill date).

drug_name.meaning: Drug name and strength as on the label (e.g. atorvastatin 20 mg tablet).

formulary_status.meaning: Formulary status of the drug on the fill date.

days_supply.meaning: Days supply dispensed; 0 on reject and reversal rows.

quantity.meaning: Quantity dispensed in NCPDP billing units.

member_copay.meaning: Copay assessed (positive) or reversed (negative); 0.00 on rejects and emergency supplies.

copay_exempt_class.meaning: Exempt drug class of the drug, none if not exempt.

exception_number.meaning: Exception or prior authorization number the fill was paid under or bridges; empty otherwise.

reject_code.meaning: Reject reason on rejected rows; none otherwise.

reversal_date.meaning: Date a fill was reversed; empty otherwise.

rx_exception_id.meaning: Primary id of the exception or override row.

exception_number.meaning: Exception or prior authorization request number (e.g. RXE-2609-04471); empty on override rows.

request_type.meaning: Kind of request, override or lock-in change.

lock_in_change_reason.meaning: Reason for a lock-in pharmacy change; not_applicable otherwise.

ndc.meaning: NDC requested; empty when not drug-specific.

rx_number.meaning: Prescription number on override rows; empty otherwise.

requested_by.meaning: Who started the request or change.

prescriber_statement_received.meaning: Whether the prescriber's supporting statement has been received.

approved_through.meaning: Last day an approval lasts; empty otherwise.

denial_reason.meaning: Reason for a denial; not_applicable otherwise.

police_report_number.meaning: Police report number given for a lost or stolen controlled substance; empty otherwise.

rx_otc_id.meaning: Primary id of the OTC ledger row.

benefit_quarter.meaning: Calendar quarter the row belongs to.

amount.meaning: Amount loaded, spent or forfeited (always positive).

order_channel.meaning: Where an order was placed; not_applicable on loads and forfeits.

order_number.meaning: Order or receipt number of a purchase; empty otherwise.

ride_benefit_id.meaning: Primary id of the transportation benefit record.

variant_name.meaning: Level of service, as the official name.

end_date.meaning: Last day of the benefit; empty while open.

close_reason.meaning: Why the benefit closed; not_applicable while open.

mobility_assessment_date.meaning: Date of the latest mobility assessment.

physician_certification_date.meaning: Date of the latest physician certification; empty when none.

suspension_start_date.meaning: First day of the current no-show suspension; empty when not suspended.

trips_remaining.meaning: Value-added trips left this benefit year (integral of the value_added_trips account).

reimbursement_owed.meaning: Approved reimbursements not yet paid (integral of the mileage_reimbursement account).

ride_trip_id.meaning: Primary id of the trip row.

trip_number.meaning: Reservation number given to the member (e.g. RL-5580213); empty on standing order and pass rows.

destination_name.meaning: Destination name and address as given.

destination_npi.meaning: NPI of the destination provider; empty for value-added destinations.

booking_channel.meaning: Channel the trip was booked through.

event_date.meaning: Date of the booking, completion, cancellation, no-show, late pickup, order start or pass issue.

notice_hours.meaning: Whole hours between a cancellation and the scheduled pickup; 0 otherwise.

minutes_late.meaning: Minutes past the end of the pickup window; 0 if on time.

standing_order_number.meaning: Standing order number (e.g. SO-24117); empty when none.

recurrence_days.meaning: Weekdays of a standing order, e.g. MON,WED,FRI; empty otherwise.

standing_order_end_date.meaning: Last date of a standing order; empty otherwise.

pass_month.meaning: Month a transit pass is valid; empty otherwise.

ride_ledger_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger row.

benefit_year.meaning: Benefit year of an allotment row; empty on reimbursement rows.

trip_number.meaning: Reservation number the row relates to; empty on allotment loads and expiries.

reimbursement_claim_number.meaning: Member reimbursement claim number (e.g. MR-260911-0387); empty on allotment rows.

claim_trip_date.meaning: Trip date the claim is for.

care_enrollment_id.meaning: Primary id of the care management episode.

variant_name.meaning: Care management tier, as the official name.

enrollment_date.meaning: Date the member consented; empty before consent.

risk_score.meaning: Predictive risk score at the latest stratification.

care_manager_name.meaning: Name of the care team lead.

hold_start_date.meaning: First day of the current hold; empty when not on hold.

hours_balance.meaning: Authorized hours not yet delivered or lapsed (integral of the personal_care_hours account).

care_activity_id.meaning: Primary id of the activity row.

attempt_outcome.meaning: Outcome of an outreach attempt or contact.

member_signed.meaning: Whether the member signed the care plan version.

discharge_date.meaning: Hospital discharge date followed up; empty otherwise.

facility_name.meaning: Hospital or facility name; empty otherwise.

care_manager_name.meaning: New care team lead on change rows; empty otherwise.

care_hours_id.meaning: Primary id of the hours row.

service_week.meaning: Monday that starts the service week.

visit_date.meaning: Visit date on delivered rows; empty otherwise.

attendant_number.meaning: Attendant identifier from the agency or self-direction roster; empty otherwise.

appeal_case_id.meaning: Primary id of the case record.

variant_name.meaning: Case type, as the official name.

case_number.meaning: Case number given to the member (e.g. AG-2609-00731).

related_reference.meaning: Reference of the decision or event concerned: auth_number, exception_number, claim_number or trip_number; empty for general grievances.

notice_date.meaning: Date on the notice being appealed, from its notice record; empty for grievances.

prior_case_number.meaning: Case number of the plan appeal an escalated case follows; empty otherwise.

due_date.meaning: Resolution due date (the date part of the due moment for expedited cases).

extension_reason.meaning: Why the due date was extended.

resolved_date.meaning: Date resolved or withdrawn; empty while open.

continuation_requested.meaning: Whether the member asked for services to continue.

continuation_balance.meaning: Cost of continued services not waived or repaid (integral of the continuation_liability account).

appeal_action_id.meaning: Primary id of the action row.

action_date.meaning: Date of the letter, submission or summary.

appeal_continuation_id.meaning: Primary id of the continuation ledger row.

service_date.meaning: Service date of a continued service; empty otherwise.

service_reference.meaning: Claim number of a continued service; empty otherwise.

amount.meaning: Amount booked, waived or repaid (always positive).

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity verification record (one per member).

verified.meaning: Whether verification passed; never goes back from true to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the human handoff record.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
